title: Ricotta Gelato with Lemon Zest
changes_from_base: Blended fresh ricotta, milk and a sugar syrup with lemon zest replace the cooked pistachio custard; no eggs and no cornflour.
summary: Barely cooked and very quick: fresh ricotta blended with milk and a sugar syrup gives a light, cheesecake-like gelato with a hint of lemon.

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Syrup
steps.text: Warm 120 ml of the milk with the sugar, corn syrup and salt in the small pan, stirring, until the sugar dissolves. Cool completely.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Put the ricotta, the remaining cold milk and the cooled syrup in the blender and blend until silky, about 45 seconds.

steps.title: Flavour
steps.text: Add the zest and pulse to mix. Taste; a little more salt makes the dairy taste sweeter.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: If the mixture is not fridge-cold, chill the blender jug for 1-2 h.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn for 15-20 min, until thick and creamy.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Spoon it into the container, smooth the top, lay baking paper on it and freeze for at least 4 h. Leave in the fridge for 10 min before scooping.

tips: Use the freshest, creamiest ricotta you can find; dry, grainy ricotta gives a grainy gelato.
Fold in chopped candied orange peel or dark chocolate in the last minute of churning.
Drizzle with honey and chopped pistachios to serve.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week; it is best fresh. Soften for 10 min in the fridge before scooping.
